name: Stage Callable Traceability Sources
description: Traceability links to Stage_Level_Architecture.json (Stage bounded orchestration, Stage owns Step composition, Stage Flow Result independent of StepExecutionResult), Step_Contract.json (Stage invokes Step through public contract), Identity.json (GPWCF supplies Stage behavior, not Pipeline orchestration), ADR-GPWCF-PREFECT-001.json (Prefect owns native execution, GPWCF retains contracts), PHASE-02 topology/acceptance records (Stage as native Prefect Parent Flow/Deployment).
